16103.name: In Between Two Mountain Walls

south.description: To the south lies In Between Two Mountain Walls.

down.description: To the down lies Up The Mountain.

16103.description:
Two walls of wet black rock rise on either hand, so close and so tall
that the sky is no more than a pale grey ribbon far overhead. Mist
creeps between them like milk poured into a crack, beading every ledge
with cold water. The gorge runs on south between the cliffs, while a way
down drops over loose scree to the bare, snow-patched slopes of the
Northern Wilderness. High on both walls, old white streaks mark the
ledges where ravens nest.

16104.name: In Between Two Mountain Walls

north.description: To the north lies In Between Two Mountain Walls.

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

16104.description:
The gorge pinches in here until you could almost touch both walls at
once, their faces slick with seepage and furred with black moss. A rough
stair of fallen slabs climbs up out of the cleft to a mountain path,
each step worn hollow by feet older than memory. Northward the gorge
winds back toward its mouth above the wilderness. Every footfall comes
back as a hollow, doubled echo, and the air tastes of wet iron.

16105.name: On A Mountain Path

south.description: To the south lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies In Between Two Mountain Walls.

16105.description:
The stair from the gorge ends on a shelf of broken slate where the wind
finds you at last, cold and wet off the mist. Two ways part here: a path
running south along the mountain's shoulder toward a summit hidden in
cloud, and a narrower track creeping west along a ledge. Behind you the
rough stair drops down into the gorge between the mountain walls. Tufts
of coarse grass shiver in every crack, strung with droplets like beads.

16106.name: On A Mountain Path

north.description: To the north lies On A Mountain Path.

up.description: To the up lies On The Mountain Top.

16106.description:
The path steepens into a scramble over tilted slabs of black rock
streaked with rusty orange lichen. From here a last steep pitch leads up
to the mountain top, which rounds away into the cloud above. North, the
path runs back along the shoulder to the shelf where the ways part. The
wind has found a voice among the slabs, keening through every crack, and
old snow clings in the shadow of each boulder.

16107.name: On The Mountain Top

down.description: To the down lies On A Mountain Path.

16107.description:
You stand on the mountain top, a bald crown of black rock scoured smooth
by the wind and glistening with the endless mist. On a squat stone
plinth sits an iron beacon basket, rusted red and long cold, left from
the days when warning fires were lit here. Mostly the cloud presses
close, but when it tears open the world falls away beneath you in a
sudden, dizzying sweep of grey peaks and dark forest. The only way off
is back down the steep pitch.

extra_descs.beacon basket iron plinth:
The basket is a cage of iron bars as thick as a thumb, rusted nearly
through and still holding a black crust of ancient charcoal. Letters cut
into the plinth have been worn by wind and rain until only one word can
still be read: WATCH.

16108.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

16108.description:
A narrow ledge runs along the face of the mountain, scarcely wider than
a handcart, with a drop beside it that vanishes into grey nothing. Iron
pegs hammered into the rock make a crude ladder going up to a higher
shelf, their heads polished bright by generations of gripping hands.
East, the ledge leads back to where the ways part above the gorge. Water
drips steadily from an overhang into a shallow basin worn in the stone.

16109.name: On A Mountain Path

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16109.description:
The ledge stops dead at the lip of a sheer drop, where the rock simply
ends and the mist begins. Gusts boil up from below, smelling of wet
stone and, very faintly, of pine. When the cloud is torn aside you can
see straight down a thousand feet of black cliff to fans of scree and
the tops of trees, a sight that turns the knees to water. West is the
only way, back to the boulder-strewn shelf.

16110.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies On A Mountain Path.

16110.description:
The pegged climb tops out on a broad shelf where several ways meet among
tumbled boulders. Ledges run off east and west along the cliff, a steep
cleft leads up toward higher ground, and the iron pegs go back down to
the ledge below. In the middle of the shelf someone has stacked a small
cairn of flat stones. A scrap of grey cloth, bleached by sun and rain,
flutters from a stick wedged in its top.

16111.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

16111.description:
A short spur of path ends beneath a deep overhang, a natural shelter
where the wind cannot quite reach. A ring of fire-blackened stones and a
smear of old charcoal show that others have waited out storms here. The
underside of the overhang is crusted with abandoned nests of sticks and
wool, glued fast with droppings. East, the path leads back to the shelf
where the ways meet.

16112.name: On A Mountain Path

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies On A Mountain Path.

16112.description:
The cleft from the shelf below opens onto a high, windswept path where
loose stones skitter at every step. Mist drags across the slope in long
grey veils, hiding the next few yards one moment and the next drawing
back to bare the black teeth of the crags all around. The path runs on
west across the slope, and the cleft leads back down to the meeting of
the ways. Juniper crouches flat against the rock, its berries frosted
blue.

16113.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16113.description:
Here the path crosses a long slope of shattered grey slate whose
fragments clink and slide underfoot like broken crockery. Above and
below, the scree runs off into the mist, and the whole slope seems ready
to shift at one careless step. Someone has laid flat stones edge to edge
to make a rough causeway across the worst of it, running east and west.
The air is thin and bitter, and it rasps in the chest.

16114.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

south.description: To the south lies On A Mountain Path.

16114.description:
The causeway of laid stones ends at a sharp corner, where the path turns
south around a rough buttress of rock. Rain has carved deep runnels down
the buttress, and a thin waterfall spills from one of them into a pool
before slipping away across the path. Eastward the causeway runs back
over the scree. Thick cushions of moss, startlingly green against the
dark rock, grow wherever the spray can reach.

16115.name: On A Mountain Path

north.description: To the north lies On A Mountain Path.

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16115.description:
Three ways meet on a saddle of wet turf between two rocky knolls. North,
the path bends back around the buttress toward the scree; east, a faint
track leads out onto a narrow spur; west, the main path carries on along
the mountain's flank. Mist pools in the saddle like water in a bowl, and
the turf squelches underfoot. A weathered post still stands crookedly at
the junction, though the sign it once carried has long since rotted
away.

16116.name: On A Mountain Path

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16116.description:
The faint track runs out along a narrow spur of rock and stops at its
blunt end, where a single wind-bent pine clings on with roots like
clutching fingers. The tree leans so far over the edge that its crown
hangs above nothing at all. Far below, mist fills the valley from wall
to wall like a sea of grey wool. The only way is back west to the
saddle.

16117.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

16117.description:
The path meets the foot of a steep gully here, choked with boulders,
that leads up the mountainside toward higher ledges. A short ledge
strikes off west, while the path runs back east to the misty saddle.
Meltwater trickles down the gully between the stones, and every boulder
is slick with green slime. High above, the walls of the gully vanish
into the cloud.

16118.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

16118.description:
This short ledge ends against a sheer slab of rock, polished by running
water into a dark mirror that gives back a dim, warped reflection. Long
scratches mark the slab at about the height of a man's chest, as though
something heavy has clawed at it and failed to climb. A cold draught
breathes from a crack at its foot. There is nothing for it but to return
east to the bottom of the gully.

16119.name: On A Mountain Path

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies On A Mountain Path.

16119.description:
The boulder gully tops out on a narrow path cut into the mountainside,
walled by dripping rock on one hand and open to a sudden drop on the
other. Where the way is steepest, square steps have been chiselled into
the stone, very old and rounded by weather. The path runs on west, and
the gully leads down among its slimy boulders. Rime clings to every
crack in the wall, glittering faintly in the grey light.

16120.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16120.description:
The path runs level along a ledge beneath a long overhang, so that a lid
of black rock hangs just above your head while open air yawns at your
other side. Icicles fringe the lip of the overhang, dripping onto the
path and freezing again into knobbly lumps underfoot. The ledge
continues east and west. Below, the mist lies so thick that the drop
looks almost solid enough to walk on.

16121.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies On A Mountain Path.

16121.description:
The ledge widens into a rough terrace where a steep path branches down
the mountainside, zigzagging toward forested slopes far below. The main
path carries on west toward a line of higher crags and runs back east
beneath the overhang. Heather grows thick on the terrace, brown and wiry
and beaded with mist. On clearer days thin threads of smoke can be seen
rising from among the distant trees.

16122.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

16122.description:
The path passes beneath a crag where a rough chimney in the rock leads
up to a higher ledge, its sides worn smooth by climbing hands and knees.
West, the path runs on toward a dark barrier just visible through the
mist; east, it returns to the heather terrace. Old iron rings, rusted
brown, are set into the rock beside the chimney, perhaps once for ropes.
The wind moans in the chimney like breath across the mouth of a jug.

16123.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies Outside A Large Cabin.

16123.description:
The path is closed here by a stout gate of lashed pine trunks, built
across a gap between two boulders and barred with a beam as thick as a
man's thigh. Through the mist beyond it a wider path runs west toward
the steep, dark roof of a large cabin, but the gate is chained and
frozen fast. Strange signs have been daubed on the gateposts in some
dark, rusty stain. The only open way is back east along the mountain
path.

extra_descs.signs gateposts gate chain:
The signs are spirals and jagged, branching lines, smeared on with a
finger in something that dried the colour of old blood. A heavy chain
has been wrapped around the beam and hammered shut, and the gate has not
moved in a long time.

16124.name: On A Mountain Path

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies At The Base Of The Mountain.

16124.description:
The path zigzags steeply down the mountainside in tight switchbacks,
each turn propped up by a crude wall of piled stones. Up the slope the
switchbacks climb back to the heather terrace, and down below the path
reaches the foot of the mountain, where dark trees crowd close. Here and
there a stake has been driven in beside the path, notched with tally
marks in a careful hand. Fresh scrapes on the stones show the path is
often used.

16125.name: At The Base Of The Mountain

north.description: To the north lies At The Edge Of A Forrest.

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

16125.description:
Here the roots of the mountain meet rolling ground of tussock grass and
lichen-crusted boulders. Behind you the switchback path climbs up the
steep slope into the mist. North, the land runs down to the edge of a
forest, where tall dark trees stand shoulder to shoulder like a wall.
Muddy boot prints cross the soft ground between the stones, and a thin
trail of woodsmoke drifts out from somewhere among the trees.

16126.name: At The Edge Of A Forrest

north.description: To the north lies A Small Path Through The Deep, Dark Forest.

south.description: To the south lies At The Base Of The Mountain.

16126.description:
You stand beneath the first great trees of the forest, where their
boughs knit together overhead into a roof so thick and close that it
shuts out the day. The light is dim and green, and the air is still and
smells of moss, rot and resin. A small path leads north between mossy
trunks into the deep, dark forest beyond. South, a bright gap between
the trunks opens onto the open ground at the foot of the mountain.

16127.name: On A Mountain Path

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16127.description:
The ledge ends in a shallow nook, scooped out of the cliff by frost and
sheltered from the worst of the wind. Its floor is matted with sticks,
moulted black feathers and the white splashes of years of droppings, the
leavings of the great birds that roost here. A sour smell of carrion
hangs in the still air. West, the ledge runs back to the head of the
chimney.

16128.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies On A Mountain Path.

16128.description:
The chimney opens at its top onto a high, airy ledge running along the
face of the mountain. West, the ledge leads into thickening mist, and
east it ends in a nook in the cliff. At your feet the chimney drops back
down to the path below, a dark slot in the rock. The wind here is fierce
and steady, flattening the few plants that grow and singing over the
edge.

16129.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16129.description:
The path crosses a broad face of slabby black rock tilted at a steep
angle, where every step must be placed with care on the wet stone.
Shallow grooves cut across the slabs give a little grip, and a rusted
chain stapled to the rock serves as a handrail along the worst stretch.
The way runs east and west across the face. Water sheets down the rock
in a thin, shining film.

16130.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

16130.description:
A crack splits the cliff here, and a rough way leads up through it
toward higher paths, its floor a staircase of wedged boulders. The main
path runs on west along the mountainside and back east across the slabs.
Tough grey lichen covers every surface the water does not sweep. When
the mist thins, tier after tier of dark crags can be seen rising above
you, lost at last in cloud.

16131.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16131.description:
Here the path winds through a field of huge fallen boulders, some as
large as cottages, tumbled from the heights in some long-ago landslide.
The way threads between them east and west, twisting so that you rarely
see more than a few paces ahead. Moss and small ferns grow in the damp
shadows at their feet. Deep gouges score one great block, as though
something with claws has sharpened them on it.

16132.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16132.description:
The boulders give way to an open stretch of path along the rim of a
broad, grassy shelf. Mist rolls across the shelf in waves, and at times
you walk in a world of grey with nothing but the path at your feet.
Small mossy cairns, knee-high, mark its outer edge every few yards so
that walkers do not stray over the drop. The way continues east among
the boulders and west along the rim.

16133.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16133.description:
The path narrows between a rock wall and a precipice, and a low parapet
of piled stones has been built along the outer edge, though stretches of
it have tumbled into the void. A spring wells from a crack in the wall,
filling a carved stone trough with icy, clear water, its lip worn smooth
by countless hands. The way runs east toward the grassy shelf and west
to a wide crossing of paths. Mist curls slowly up over the parapet.

16134.name: On A Mountain Path

north.description: To the north lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

south.description: To the south lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16134.description:
This is a broad crossing of paths on a high saddle of the mountain, its
ground trodden bare and muddy. North, a path climbs onto the rim of the
Crescent Cliffs, whose great curve shows dimly through the mist; east
and west, long paths follow the mountainside; south, another heads off
along a grassy ledge. A tall standing stone, carved with weathered
signs, keeps watch at the centre of the crossing. Here the wind seems to
blow from every side at once.

extra_descs.standing stone signs carved:
Each face of the stone bears a simple carved arrow, softened by
centuries of weather. Above the arrow that points toward the cliffs,
someone has cut a raven with its wings spread wide, and the hollows of
the carving are still dark with old soot.

16135.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16135.description:
The path rises gently east toward the crossing of ways on the high
saddle and runs back west along the slate terrace. Tall heaps of broken
stone, the spoil of some old quarrying, line one side of the path, and
the wedge marks of long-dead quarrymen still show in the rock face
behind them. The wind flings grit into your eyes. Here and there a
stubborn harebell nods in a sheltered crack.

16136.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16136.description:
The path runs along a terrace of flat slate slabs, laid down by nature
as neatly as any paving. Water pools in the cracks between them and
freezes into a skin of ice that crackles underfoot. The terrace
continues east toward a crossing of paths and west toward a broken
signpost. Just below the path, mist fills a hollow to the brim, smooth
as a pond, and the tops of a few stunted pines poke up through it.

16137.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

south.description: To the south lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16137.description:
A side path branches south here from the long mountain path, heading
toward lower ledges, while the main way runs east and west across the
mountainside. A broken signpost leans at the fork, its arms long gone,
but a dwarven rune carved into the post still points the way south. Rock
and heather stretch away on every side, half hidden in drifting cloud. A
small cairn of white quartz stones sits at the foot of the post.

extra_descs.signpost rune post dwarven:
The rune is cut deep and square in the dwarven fashion: a hammer above
an open door. Dwarves carve it to mean the road home, and someone has
rubbed it with soot to keep it clear.

16138.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16138.description:
Here the path climbs over a low shoulder of the mountain, a hump of
short, wind-bitten grass and scattered stones. From its crest, when the
mist lifts, you can follow the path with your eye as it runs away east
and west along the flank of the mountain. A single standing stone,
waist-high and leaning, marks the crest. The turf is pitted with the
small, sharp hoofprints of goats.

16139.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16139.description:
The path runs along a sheltered ledge at the foot of a long cliff, whose
face is pocked with small caves and hollows. East, the ledge rises
toward a grassy shoulder of the mountain; west, it reaches the head of
the ravine. Rivulets run down the cliff after every rain, and the ledge
is muddy and dotted with puddles. In one of them, preserved in the mud,
is the print of an enormous bare foot, broad and long-toed.

16140.name: On A Mountain Path

north.description: To the north lies On A Mountain Path.

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16140.description:
Three paths meet at the head of the ravine, where a stream spills over a
lip of rock and plunges out of sight. North, the way follows the
ravine's rim; east, a long path runs beneath a cliff; west, a track
heads out across a bare slope of scree. The air is loud with rushing
water and cold with spray. A crude footbridge of logs, green with moss,
crosses the stream.

16141.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16141.description:
The track crosses a long, bare slope of grey scree and tilted slabs,
heading west toward the foot of a steep crag and east back to the
meeting of paths by the stream. Nothing grows here but lichen, and the
stones rattle and slide at every step. In the mist the slope seems to go
on forever, without top or bottom. A cold wind hisses over the scree
like breath through teeth.

16142.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

16142.description:
The scree ends against the foot of a steep crag, where a way leads up
through a cleft in the rock, scrambling over boulders. East, the track
runs back across the scree slope. The cleft is dark and wet, and a cold
wind pours down it. Someone has wedged a few logs crosswise in the cleft
to serve as steps, and they are worn smooth and slippery.

16143.name: On A Mountain Path

west.description: To the west lies At The Base Of The Mountain.

up.description: To the up lies At The Base Of The Mountain.

down.description: To the down lies On A Mountain Path.

16143.description:
The cleft tops out on a steep slope of boulders and rough grass. Above,
the slope climbs up toward broken ground at the foot of a sheer peak,
and a level track leads west to the same place along the edge of the
slope. Down through the cleft lies the long scree slope. Tiny mountain
flowers cling to the cracks, white and yellow, and the wind carries the
smell of snow.

16144.name: At The Base Of The Mountain

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies On A Mountain Path.

16144.description:
This is a rough hollow of hummocky ground and boulders at the base of a
sheer peak whose black face rises straight into the cloud. A track leads
east toward the head of the cleft, and a steep path goes down a gully
toward a ledge below. Tough grass and white tufts of cotton-grass grow
in boggy patches, and pools of black water mirror the grey sky. The peak
drips constantly, its streams pattering on the rocks.

16145.name: On A Mountain Path

north.description: To the north lies On A Mountain Path.

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

south.description: To the south lies On A Mountain Path.

16145.description:
The side path comes out onto a broad ledge where the ways part again.
North lies the fork with the broken signpost; east, a short track runs
out to a point of rock; south, the path follows the ledge toward the
lower slopes. Rocks fallen from the cliff above litter the ledge, and a
few have burst apart on the path. Rough steps cut into the stone show
that this was once a well-kept way.

16146.name: On A Mountain Path

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16146.description:
A short track ends at a point of rock jutting out over the mountainside,
its surface scarred by long, deep gouges where great claws have gripped
it again and again. Dark streaks stain the stone, and a rank, reptile
smell hangs in the air. Below, the mist hides everything but the faint
sound of falling water. The only way back is west to the ledge, and it
is a relief to take it.

16147.name: On A Mountain Path

north.description: To the north lies On A Mountain Path.

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies On A Mountain Path.

16147.description:
A grassy ledge runs from the high crossing of paths, north back to the
saddle and east along the mountainside. A steep, slippery way also goes
down from the ledge, following a long gully. The grass is cropped short
by grazing goats, and their droppings dot the turf. The mist rolls up
the gully from below, cold and wet, and breaks over the ledge like a
slow grey tide.

16148.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16148.description:
The ledge narrows as it runs east along the mountainside toward the scar
of a rockfall, with the rock wall leaning close on one side. West, it
widens toward the head of the gully. Streaks of rust-red stain the wall
where iron-bearing water seeps from the rock. Water drips steadily from
above, and every sound comes back from the wall twice over.

16149.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16149.description:
The path crosses the top of a steep slope of loose stones here, the
remains of a great rockfall. A rough way has been cleared through the
debris, running east and west. Above, a raw pale scar on the cliff shows
where the rocks broke away. Some of the boulders have been crushed to
fragments, as if by a giant's hammer.

16150.name: On A Mountain Path

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

16150.description:
The ledge ends at the foot of a steep rock step, where a way leads up
toward a dark opening high in the cliff. West, the ledge runs back
across the rockfall. A faint, sour smell of smoke and sulphur drifts
down from above. The rock here is warm to the touch in places, strangely
so on this cold mountain.

16151.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies Path To The Dwarven Village.

16151.description:
Here the mountain path makes its last turn before it drops toward the
village of the dwarves, the turning point that every traveller on the
road below looks up to. A broad stair of dressed stone leads down from
the ledge, well made in the dwarven way, with grooves cut for grip.
East, the ledge runs back around the banded buttress. The air is a
little milder here, and the grass grows longer between the stones.

16152.name: On A Mountain Path

north.description: To the north lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16152.description:
The ledge curves around a buttress, and the path follows it west toward
the turning where it begins its descent to the dwarven lands. North, the
ledge runs back toward the parting of the ways. The buttress is banded
grey and white, and someone has chiselled neat steps across a gap where
the ledge has fallen away. The mist below glows faintly, as if sunlight
lies on the valleys beneath it.

16153.name: On A Mountain Path

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

up.description: To the up lies At The Base Of The Mountain.

16153.description:
A steep gully climbs up from here to a boggy hollow at the base of a
sheer peak. West, the path runs along a narrow ledge toward a buttress
banded grey and white. Loose stones fill the gully, and every step sends
a few clattering away. Sedge and moss grow along the sides of the gully,
and the air is damp and still.

16154.name: On A Mountain Path

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies At The Base Of The Mountain.

16154.description:
The steep gully runs down the mountainside between walls of crumbling
rock, its floor a jumble of loose stones. Up the gully lies the grassy
ledge below the crossing of paths; down it, the way reaches the foot of
the mountain. The mist is thick and wet, and the walls drip. Rowan and
birch saplings cling to the sides of the gully, their roots bared by
rain.

16155.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies By A Dark Cave Entrance.

down.description: To the down lies On A Mountain Path.

16155.description:
The rock step tops out on a narrow ledge before the mouth of a dark
cave, which opens just east of you. Down below, the ledge and the
rockfall are visible through the mist. The ledge is strewn with black
soot and gravel, and the rock around the cave mouth is smudged dark as
if by old fires. The air is noticeably warmer here, and it shimmers
faintly over the cave.

16156.name: By A Dark Cave Entrance

east.description: To the east lies Inside A Dark Cave.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16156.description:
You stand just within the mouth of a dark cave, its rough ceiling of
black rock low overhead and its walls stained with soot. Grey light
comes in from the ledge to the west, but it fails quickly, and the cave
runs east into deep darkness. A warm draught blows steadily outward,
smelling of smoke and hot stone. The floor is gritty with ash.

16157.name: Inside A Dark Cave

west.description: To the west lies By A Dark Cave Entrance.

down.description: To the down lies The Sphere Room.

16157.description:
The cave opens into a rough chamber where the darkness is almost total,
and the air is warm and close. In the middle of the floor a round shaft
goes down into the rock, but it has been sealed with a great slab of
stone, cracked across, through which a faint red glow and a breath of
heat seep. West, the passage leads back to the cave mouth. The walls are
glazed and blistered, as if great heat had once licked them.

extra_descs.slab shaft stone glow:
The slab is carved around its rim with a ring of runes, most of them
chipped away. Heat breathes steadily through the crack across it, and if
you press an ear to the stone you can hear, far below, a slow and heavy
rumbling like the breath of a forge.

16158.name: At The Base Of The Mountain

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

16158.description:
The gully spills out here at the base of the mountain onto a fan of
stones and gravel, beyond which the ground is a tangle of boulders,
bracken and thorn that no path crosses. The only way on is back up the
gully. The walls of a small stone hut stand at the edge of the fan,
roofless and filled with nettles. Mist hangs low over everything.

16159.name: On Top of the Crescent Cliffs

south.description: To the south lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

16159.description:
You stand at the first horn of the Crescent Cliffs, where the rim of a
vast, curving precipice begins. The edge sweeps away west in a great
arc, and on its inner side the rock falls sheer into a bowl of mist so
deep that no bottom can be seen. South, a path leads back to the
crossing on the saddle. Nests of sticks cling to the ledges just under
the rim, and the wind never rests.

16160.name: On Top of the Crescent Cliffs

east.description: To the east lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

west.description: To the west lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

16160.description:
The path keeps close to the rim of the cliffs here, at times no more
than an arm's length from the edge. Across the misty gulf, the far arm
of the crescent shows as a dark line of crags whenever the cloud thins.
The way runs east toward the horn of the cliffs and west along the
curving rim. Frost has split the rock underfoot into great blocks, and
some of them lean outward as if waiting to fall.

16161.name: On Top of the Crescent Cliffs

east.description: To the east lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

west.description: To the west lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

16161.description:
A stream crosses the clifftop here and pours straight over the edge,
falling in a long white plume into the gulf. Its roar fills the air, and
a fine cold spray drifts back over the rim, glazing the nearby rocks
with ice. Flat stepping stones carry the path over the stream, east and
west along the rim. Ferns and mosses grow lush and green in the constant
wet, the only soft things on the whole clifftop.

16162.name: On Top of the Crescent Cliffs

north.description: To the north lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

east.description: To the east lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

16162.description:
Here the rim of the cliffs bends sharply, and the path turns with it to
run north along the edge of the gulf. East, the rim runs back toward the
roar of the waterfall. A pillar of rock, split away from the cliff by
frost, stands just off the edge across a gap that no sane traveller
would try to leap. Its flat top is heaped with old nests and whitened
with droppings.

16163.name: On Top of the Crescent Cliffs

north.description: To the north lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

south.description: To the south lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16163.description:
A side path leaves the rim here, heading west away from the edge across
the open mountainside. The clifftop runs on north and south, curving
gently, with the gulf a vast grey hollow at your feet. A low stone hut,
roofless and half collapsed, crouches beside the path, perhaps once a
lookout's shelter. Thin grass and starry white saxifrage grow between
its fallen stones.

16164.name: On Top of the Crescent Cliffs

north.description: To the north lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

south.description: To the south lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

16164.description:
The rim narrows to a knife-edge of rock, with the gulf on one side and a
steep run of scree on the other. A rope of twisted hide, stiff with age,
has been strung between iron stakes along the crest as a handline, and
the path follows it north and south. When the wind gusts it is hard to
stay upright. Through rents in the mist you may glimpse the black water
of a tarn far, far below.

16165.name: On Top of the Crescent Cliffs

east.description: To the east lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

south.description: To the south lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16165.description:
This is the far bend of the crescent, where the rim turns once more and
runs east along the other side of the gulf. A path leaves the cliffs to
the west, heading toward the tall wall of a tower that shows dimly
through the mist. South, the knife-edge crest runs back along the rim. A
great cairn, taller than a man, has been raised here at the turning, and
every passing hand seems to have added a stone.

16166.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

west.description: To the west lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

16166.description:
The path heads west from the cliffs toward a tall, round tower of dark
stone that looms larger with every step, its top lost in the cloud. The
ground is a rough slope of heather and broken rock, cut by little
runnels of water. East, the way leads back to the great cairn on the rim
of the Crescent Cliffs. Hobnailed boots have left their marks in the
muddy patches, some going toward the tower and some coming away.

16167.name: On Top of the Crescent Cliffs

east.description: To the east lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

west.description: To the west lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

16167.description:
Along this stretch the clifftop is broad and grassy, but the rim has
crumbled into a row of jagged bays, and the path keeps well back from
them. It runs east along the crescent and west toward the great cairn at
the bend. Clumps of pink thrift and wiry grass grow among the rocks,
pressed flat by the gusts. A wet wind blows across the gulf, carrying a
fine, drifting rain.

16168.name: On Top of the Crescent Cliffs

east.description: To the east lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

west.description: To the west lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

16168.description:
Here the cliff juts out in a great overhang, and the path runs along its
very top, so that the rock beneath your feet hangs over empty air.
Through cracks in the overhang you can see the mist swirling straight
below. The path continues east and west along the rim. Frost-shattered
rock lies everywhere, and it is plain that pieces of this ledge break
away into the gulf each winter.

16169.name: On Top of the Crescent Cliffs

east.description: To the east lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

west.description: To the west lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

16169.description:
The clifftop rises into a hump of bare black rock, and from its crown,
when the mist allows, the whole sweep of the crescent can be seen
curving away behind you. The rim narrows ahead to the east and runs back
west across the hump. Deep scratches score the rock in sets of three,
too broad and too deep for any bird, where something heavy lands often.
The drop into the gulf is sheer and dizzying.

16170.name: On Top of the Crescent Cliffs

west.description: To the west lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

16170.description:
The rim of the cliffs ends here at the far horn of the crescent, a
narrow point of rock thrust out over the gulf. There is nothing beyond
but cloud and the endless sound of the wind. An iron spike has been
driven deep into the rock at the very tip, with a few rotted strands of
rope still knotted around it. From this lonely point the clifftop runs
back west along the crescent.

extra_descs.iron spike rope strands:
The spike is as thick as a thumb and driven deep into a crack in the
rock. Whoever tied a rope here was either lowering something into the
gulf or climbing up out of it, and the rotten strands no longer tell
which.

16171.name: Overlooking A Great View

south.description: To the south lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

16171.description:
You stand at the tip of a rocky spur thrust out from the mountain, and
when the mist parts the whole realm seems to open beneath you. Dark
forests roll away below, a glacier glitters beyond them among white
snowfields, and far off the land fades into a blue haze where rivers
wind and the smoke of distant towns rises. The drop from the spur is
sheer on three sides, enough to turn the strongest stomach. The only way
back is south to the foot of the tower.

extra_descs.view haze realm forests:
If you look long enough into the far haze you can make out a pale smudge
that might be the walls of Garathorm, and at the very edge of sight a
dull grey gleam that can only be the Sea of Storms.

16172.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On Top of the Crescent Cliffs.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16172.description:
The path runs along the foot of a low ridge, joining the Crescent Cliffs
to the east with the ways that wander west across the mountain. The
ridge shelters the path from the worst of the wind, and heather grows
thick and springy underfoot. Scattered boulders wear caps of green moss.
Now and again the mist pulls back to show the rim of the cliffs, sharp
against a grey sky.

16173.name: On A Mountain Path

north.description: To the north lies On A Mountain Path.

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

south.description: To the south lies On A Mountain Path.

16173.description:
Ways part on a shelf of rock beneath a dripping cliff. North, the path
bends around a crag; east, it leads toward the Crescent Cliffs; south,
it continues across a slope of tumbled rocks. A deep pool lies in a
hollow of the shelf, black and cold and fed by the drips from above.
Thick moss rims its edge like a collar of green velvet.

16174.name: On A Mountain Path

north.description: To the north lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16174.description:
The path picks its way across a slope of tumbled black rocks, each one
slick with wet and blotched with white lichen. It runs north toward the
pool beneath the dripping cliff and west toward the edge of a ravine.
The gaps between the rocks are deep enough to swallow a leg, and the
footing is treacherous. A thin sleet comes on the wind, stinging the
face.

16175.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

south.description: To the south lies On A Mountain Path.

16175.description:
The path bends at the edge of a deep ravine, turning south along its rim
and running east back across the tumbled rocks. A stream rushes along
the ravine floor far below, white with foam, and its noise rises through
the mist. A single flat slab bridges a narrow side cleft. Stunted rowans
grow out of the ravine's walls, their red berries bright against the
black rock.

16176.name: On A Mountain Path

south.description: To the south lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16176.description:
The path turns a corner around a jutting crag, heading south along the
mountainside and west toward the paths below the tower. A small shrine
has been built into a niche in the crag, a shelf of flat stone bearing a
carved figure so worn that it is impossible to tell whether it is a man
or a bird. Pebbles and scraps of bright cloth have been left on the
shelf as offerings. The mist drips from everything.

extra_descs.shrine figure niche carved:
The figure has the hunched shoulders of a cloaked man, or perhaps the
folded wings of a great bird. Its face has weathered away entirely, but
the stone around its feet is polished smooth by the touch of many hands.

16177.name: On A Mountain Path

north.description: To the north lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16177.description:
Three ways meet on a slope of broken rock below the tower, whose dark
bulk stands to the north at the end of a short track. East, a path winds
off toward the Crescent Cliffs; west, another runs along the
mountainside into the mist. The rocks here are spattered with orange and
yellow lichen, the brightest colours on the whole grey mountain. A thin,
cold rain falls more often than not.

16178.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16178.description:
The path runs west from the junction below the tower across a long slope
dotted with boulders and tufts of tough grass, heading toward a frozen
stream. Eastward it returns to that junction beneath the tower. Mist
settles here in heavy banks, and sounds carry strangely through it, so
that near noises seem far and far ones near. Patches of old snow lie in
the hollows.

16179.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16179.description:
Here the path crosses a frozen stream on a natural bridge of rock,
beneath which water gurgles unseen. The way runs east across the
boulder-dotted slope and west toward a fork on a saddle. Icicles hang
from the underside of the rock bridge, and frost has furred the stones
white. The cold here is sharp and still, and the air smells of iron.

16180.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

south.description: To the south lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Mountain Path.

16180.description:
Paths part on a narrow saddle between two hummocks of bare rock. East,
the way leads back over the frozen stream; south, a path heads toward
the long descent to the mountain's base; west, a short track leads out
onto a promontory. A ring of stones marks an old campsite, its ashes
long cold and soaked by rain. Mist drifts across the saddle in thick,
slow banks.

16181.name: On A Mountain Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

16181.description:
The track ends on a promontory of bare rock, ringed by sheer drops. When
the mist parts you can look out across a sea of dark forest far below,
stretching away until it fades into grey. The rock is scoured clean by
the wind, and nothing grows here, not even lichen. A bare spine of rock
leads back east to the saddle.

16182.name: On A Mountain Path

north.description: To the north lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies On A Mountain Path.

16182.description:
The path begins its long descent here, dropping over the edge of the
saddle in a series of steep, rocky steps. North, the way returns to the
saddle and its old campsite. Below, the mountainside falls away into
thinning mist, through which the dark green of forest can sometimes be
seen. Loose stones and gravel make the footing slippery.

16183.name: On A Mountain Path

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

down.description: To the down lies At The Base Of The Mountain.

16183.description:
The path winds down the steep lower slopes of the mountain in tight
turns, the bare rock giving way to grass and patches of heather. Up the
slope it climbs back toward the saddle; down below, it reaches the foot
of the mountain, where the forest begins. The air grows less bitter as
you descend, and the mist thins to a light haze. The first stunted pines
grow here, leaning away from the wind.

16184.name: At The Base Of The Mountain

north.description: To the north lies On The Taiga.

up.description: To the up lies On A Mountain Path.

16184.description:
You stand at the foot of Mount Ravenmist, where the steep slopes give
way to rolling ground of moss and stones. North, the dark trees of the
taiga begin, a forest of spruce and pine reaching away into the Northern
Wilderness. Behind you, the path climbs up the mountainside in tight
switchbacks into the mist. The ground is soft and springy, and the air
smells of resin and wet earth.

16185.name: By A Tall Tower Wall

north.description: To the north lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

east.description: To the east lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

16185.description:
The path bends around the curve of the tower, its foot a jumble of mossy
rocks and old grey snow that never quite melts in the shadow of the
wall. A wooden stake has been driven into the ground at the bend, hung
with small skulls and strings of black feathers, a warning or a ward.
The way continues north and east around the base. Above, the top of the
tower is lost in the cloud.

extra_descs.stake skulls feathers ward:
Seven small raven skulls, bleached and polished, are threaded on a cord
between bunches of black feathers and knucklebones. Outcasts set such
stakes where they keep watch, believing that the ravens will carry them
word of anyone who passes.

16186.name: By A Tall Tower Wall

east.description: To the east lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

south.description: To the south lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

16186.description:
The path around the tower meets a track here, which leads south away
from the wall across a slope of broken rock. East and west, the path
follows the tower's curve. A low wall of piled stones forms a rough pen
against the tower's base, once perhaps for goats, now empty and full of
nettles. Mist trails across the face of the tower like smoke from a
doused fire.

16187.name: By A Tall Tower Wall

north.description: To the north lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

west.description: To the west lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

16187.description:
You stand at the foot of a tall, round tower whose curving wall of dark,
rough-dressed stone rises sheer into the mist above you. A path circles
the base of the tower, running north and west around the curve, while
the way east leads back toward the Crescent Cliffs. No door shows in the
wall on this side, only narrow slits far overhead. The lowest courses of
stone are green with moss and pitted by weather.

16188.name: By A Tall Tower Wall

north.description: To the north lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

south.description: To the south lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

16188.description:
The path curves around the foot of the tower, the dark wall always at
your shoulder. A doorway was once set into the stone here, but it has
been blocked up with rough blocks and lumpy mortar, now cracked and
sprouting weeds. The path continues north and south around the curve.
Water drips steadily from the masonry, and the ground at the wall's foot
is a strip of puddles and moss.

extra_descs.doorway blocks mortar door:
The blocks that fill the doorway are far cruder than the tower's own
stone, and the mortar has been slapped on in haste and smoothed with
bare hands. Whoever sealed this door did it from the outside, and did
not mean it ever to be opened again.

16189.name: By A Tall Tower Wall

east.description: To the east lies The Crevice Between The Paths.

south.description: To the south lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

west.description: To the west lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

16189.description:
Beside the tower, a narrow crevice opens in the mountainside to the
east, but it is choked with fallen boulders and a tangle of frozen
thornbrush, and no one has forced a way through in years. The path
around the tower runs south and west along the curve of the wall. Crude
arrows and runes have been scratched into the tower stones at shoulder
height. The mist hangs heavy and still in the lee of the wall.

16190.name: By A Tall Tower Wall

north.description: To the north lies Overlooking A Great View.

east.description: To the east lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

west.description: To the west lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

16190.description:
On this side of the tower the ground falls away sharply, and a short
path leads north onto a jutting spur of rock where, it is said, the
finest view on the mountain is to be had. The path around the tower runs
east and west along its curving wall. Arrow slits high in the masonry
stare out over the spur. The wind blows hard and cold here, tugging at
your clothes.

16191.name: By A Tall Tower Wall

east.description: To the east lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

south.description: To the south lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

16191.description:
Here the tower wall is scorched black in a broad smear, as though a
great fire once raged against it, and the stones are cracked and flaking
from the heat. The path curves around the base, east toward the spur of
the great view and south along the wall. Charred stumps of timber jut
from sockets in the masonry, all that remains of some wooden stair or
gallery. Sooty water drips from them onto the path.

16192.name: By A Tall Tower Wall

north.description: To the north lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

south.description: To the south lies By A Tall Tower Wall.

16192.description:
The path runs close beneath the tower, which leans very slightly outward
here, so that it always seems about to topple onto you. A heap of fallen
masonry from the upper wall lies half buried in moss beside the path.
The way leads north and south around the base. Ferns sprout from the
cracks, and a thin stream of water trickles from a slit far above,
spattering onto the stones.

647200.name: giant raven bird
647200.long_desc: A giant raven hunches on a ledge, watching you with one bright black eye.
647200.description:
It is as big as a hound, its feathers black with an oily purple sheen
and its beak as long and heavy as a hatchet blade. It moves in short,
stiff hops, head cocked, plainly weighing whether you are dead yet or
merely soon to be. A few bright threads and a glint of tarnished silver
are caught among the ruffled feathers at its throat.

647201.name: outcast scout man
647201.long_desc: An outcast scout crouches among the rocks, a loaded crossbow resting across one knee.
647201.description:
He is lean and weathered, wrapped in a cloak sewn from hundreds of black
raven feathers that makes him hard to tell from the wet rock around him.
An exile's brand puckers one cheek, and his eyes never stop moving. A
belt of knives and a quiver of short, heavy bolts hang at his hips.

647202.name: mountain troll
647202.long_desc: A hulking mountain troll squats among the boulders, gnawing on something that cracks.
647202.description:
Grey-green hide as thick as bark covers its hunched body, crusted with
lichen and dried mud so that, sitting still, it could pass for a
boulder. Its arms hang to its knees and end in broad, cracked claws, and
small red eyes glitter under its heavy brow. Around its waist it wears a
crude belt of scarred hide, cut from some lesser troll it has eaten.

647203.name: rock wyvern
647203.long_desc: A rock wyvern clings to the crag with hooked wings, its grey hide hard to tell from the stone.
647203.description:
It is a lean, long-necked beast the size of a horse, its leathery wings
tipped with hooks for gripping cliffs and its hide the mottled grey of
weathered granite. A barbed tail lashes slowly behind it, and its jaws
are crowded with curved yellow fangs. It smells of cold stone and old
blood.

747200.name: cloak raven feather feathers black
747200.room_desc: A cloak of glossy black raven feathers lies here in a rustling heap.
747200.description: Hundreds of raven feathers have been sewn overlapping onto a backing of oiled wool, so that the cloak sheds rain like a bird's back and blends into wet black rock. It rustles faintly whenever it moves.

747201.name: belt troll hide
747201.room_desc: A thick belt of grey-green troll hide lies coiled here.
747201.description: A broad strip of troll hide, grey-green and tough as old boot leather, punched with crude holes and fastened with a bone toggle. Even cut from its owner, the hide seems slowly to knit its own scratches closed.

747202.name: crossbow outcast
747202.room_desc: A short, heavy crossbow of dark wood lies here.
747202.description: A short, heavy crossbow of dark ash bound with iron, its stock carved with the slashed-through rune that outcasts take as their mark. The string is waxed against the damp, and the cocking lever is worn bright with use.

747203.name: fang wyvern tooth
747203.room_desc: A long, curved fang, yellow as old ivory, lies here.
747203.description: A curved fang as long as a hand, ridged and yellow, with a groove down its inner edge where venom once ran. Alchemists and trophy-hunters pay well for such things.

747204.name: brooch silver tarnished
747204.room_desc: A tarnished silver brooch lies here, glinting dully.
747204.description: A round silver brooch worked with a pattern of knotted lines, black with tarnish and bent at the pin. Ravens carry off anything that shines, and this has plainly spent years in a nest.
